mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol may increase citalopram plasma concentrations through CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inhibition, while citalopram may slightly increase estrogen levels; additive effects on bleeding and serotonergic activity are possible.
action: Monitor for increased citalopram side effects (hyponatremia, QT prolongation, serotonin syndrome) and bleeding risk; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical vigilance is warranted.
